rooms.name: Warehouse Loading Dock
rooms.description: A cracked concrete apron under a rusted awning. Roll-up doors sit half open, and the smell of machine oil and stale rain hangs in the air. The alley you came in from lies back the way you came.

rooms.name: Warehouse Floor
rooms.description: Rows of shrink-wrapped pallets rise toward flickering sodium lights. Narrow lanes between the racks give plenty of cover — for you, and for whoever is watching the stock.

rooms.name: Back Storage Room
rooms.description: A cramped room behind the racking, lit by a single bare tube. Crates and lockboxes are stacked to the ceiling in no order anyone sane could explain.

items.name: Sealed Courier Package
items.description: A hard-shell courier case, corporate seals intact. Exactly what the job description promised.

interactables.name: Ledger Terminal
interactables.description: An old inventory terminal, still logged in. The gang's shipping records scroll past — someone sloppy runs this place.
